# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This guide identifies one representative verse from each of the Bible's 1,189 chapters and explains why that verse was selected within the larger context of the chapter.

Each biblical book begins with a **Book Summary Insight**. Every chapter then includes a **Key Verse**, **Short Identifier**, **Why This Verse**, and **Chapter Insight**. The selections are intended as a study companion rather than an authoritative ranking of Scripture.

Use the table of contents or website search to move directly to any biblical book or selected verse.

::: {.callout-note title="A Study Companion"}
No single verse can communicate the full depth of an entire chapter. Readers are encouraged to read every chapter in full and consider the selected verse within its literary and theological context.
:::
